edges.subject: CLN1
edges.quote: Infantile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (INCL), also known as CLN1-disease, is a devastating neurodegenerative lysosomal storage disorder (LSD), caused by inactivating mutations in the CLN1 gene.

edges.subject: infantile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: The Cln1-/- mice, which mimic INCL, manifest progressive neuroinflammation contributing to neurodegeneration.

edges.subject: infantile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis

edges.subject: microRNA-155
edges.quote: Previously, it has been reported that microRNA-155 (miR-155) regulates inflammation and miR profiling in Cln1-/- mouse brain showed that the level of miR-155 was upregulated.
